visualCharacteristics.purpose: image column beside a copy column in the 12-column grid (image leads on mobile)
visualCharacteristics.layout: 4-1-6 grid by default; 5-1-6 with the wide-media option
visualCharacteristics.notes: Text authored in the image cell (e.g. a small heading above an infographic) stays in the image column, centered. In the copy, a short line right before a heading renders as an eyebrow; <hr> is a divider.

contentPattern.structure: one row: image cell (<picture>, optionally with a small heading/text above or below) | copy cell (headings, paragraphs, eyebrow lines, <hr>, CTA links)

usage: Image beside heading + copy bands (PGA TOUR ambassador, New Graduates recruitment timeline).
reuseGuidance: Add the wide-media option when the image column is 5 of 12 columns (5-1-6) as on the New Graduates page.
